title: Compact diagrams have filtered-colimit-preserving cocone transport
statement:
Use the universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$, $\kappa$-smallness, $\kappa$-filteredness and $\kappa$-compactness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], coherent cocones and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the join coslice and its projection of [lem-cbc-relative-coslice-left-fibration], and space-valued classification of [lem-coef-space-transport-classification]. Let $\kappa\in\mathcal U$ be an infinite regular cardinal and let $\mathcal E$ be a locally small quasicategory fitting in $\mathcal U'$ and admitting all small $\kappa$-filtered colimits. Let $L$ be a $\kappa$-small simplicial set and $q:L\to\mathcal E$ have $\kappa$-compact values at every vertex. The space-valued functor
$$G_q:\mathcal E\longrightarrow\mathcal S_{\mathcal U'}$$
classified by the left fibration $\mathcal E_{q/}\to\mathcal E$ preserves all small $\kappa$-filtered colimiting coherent cocones. In particular, for every such colimiting cocone $p:I\to\mathcal E$, $p\to\Delta_I c$, the induced coherent cocone $G_qp\to\Delta_I G_q(c)$ is colimiting in spaces, with its actual image cocone maps. The empty simplicial set $L$ is allowed. No colimit of $q$ is assumed to exist.

source.place: Corollary 5.3.4.14, printed p. 401, with Definition 5.3.4.5, printed p. 396 (a compact left fibration is classified by a filtered-colimit-preserving functor). Read online 2026-10-17; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical theorem.
